summary: A1 Proposal review completed with changes-requested. The bundle is structurally valid, preserves the A1 boundary, and carries the approved ESM, Node typings, and test-typecheck decisions. One blocking configuration gap remains: the test tsconfig inherits rootDir=src while including tests outside src, so the promised test TypeScript typecheck cannot work as specified.

blockingFindings.title: Test tsconfig cannot include tests outside the inherited rootDir
blockingFindings.evidence: Production tsconfig fixes rootDir to src. The proposed tsconfig.test.json extends it and includes tests/**/*.ts, but the Proposal bundle does not override rootDir to the repository root. TypeScript requires input files that would be emitted to be under rootDir; noEmit stops output but does not make the inherited project layout coherent for the stated test typecheck contract.
blockingFindings.impact: npm run typecheck cannot reliably cover tests/unit and tests/fixtures, contradicting the Proposal's required production-and-test typecheck and making Apply fail its required verification.
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: Add compilerOptions.rootDir: "." to tsconfig.test.json in Design, Task 1.3, and the TypeScript-configuration Requirement/Scenario. Keep noEmit true; do not introduce a test build output.
